messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.name: list_my_orders

messages.text:
No. A rejected proposal does not keep the refund window open. The request must be made within 30 days of delivery, and the earlier-request exception does not apply to a proposal that a staff member rejected (refund-policy/v2/window).

Your order shows the cushion was delivered on October 9, 2026, so the 30-day deadline was November 8, 2026. The recorded request was created on November 2, within that window, but it was rejected; a new request now would be outside the deadline. (refund-policy/v2/window)
